annotations.title: Chile: employer cost of an employee

description: Compute the monthly cost of an employee for a Chilean employer: taxable pay with legal gratificación and overtime, plus employer contributions (Ley 21.735 incl. SIS, unemployment insurance, accident insurance, SANNA) with UF ceilings. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/costo-empleador via x402.

anios_servicio.description: Years with the employer (indefinite contracts over 11 years pay 0.8% unemployment insurance).

bonos_imponibles.description: Other taxable monthly bonuses in CLP.

gratificacion.description: art50 = 25% of pay capped at 4.75 minimum wages a year (default); ninguna = not paid monthly.

horas_extra.description: Overtime hours in the month (50% surcharge).

jornada_semanal.description: Agreed weekly hours if part-time (default: legal maximum, 42 h since 26-Apr-2026).

mutual_adicional.description: Additional accident-insurance rate in % for the activity (the basic 0.90% is already included).

periodo.description: Pay month YYYY-MM (default: current month; from 2026-08).
